invariants: Do not open visible CMD windows for ecosystem automation.
Do not kill required CMD build subprocesses just to hide their windows.
Use the canonical control plane instead of duplicating global execution rules.
New repositories must be registered in PROJECT_REGISTRY.json.
Do not wait for Desktop Commander availability when GitHub Runner transport is available.
release_invariant: main changes are validated before promotion to control-plane-stable

remote_execution.rule: Do not wait for Desktop Commander. Use the authenticated GitHub Runner queue when local Windows execution is required.

discovery.primary: Enumerate repositories accessible through the authenticated GitHub connector and probe the repository root for BLACKGOLD_RUNNER_CONTROL.json.

remote_execution.activation_rule: Permanent installer installs Control Plane first, then activates the GitHub Runner. Background repair never opens interactive GitHub login.
